criteria.criterion: In-process ASGI (docker NOT required): `/health` from the FastMCP `streamable_http_app` returns JSON with an integer `in_flight`. Oracle: `in_flight` reads 0 at idle, increments while a stubbed certified op is held in flight, returns to 0 after — via the real endpoint through a Starlette TestClient; a trivial read does NOT move it (contrast). `/health` also returns 200 WITHOUT a bearer while `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=1` (auth-exemption oracle).

Fail-closed boot: a non-loopback bind with NO TLS-at-edge/allowlist ack makes `build_server` raise `McpStartupError` (ADR-0050 guard message); with the ack it boots. Oracle: the existing `_resolve_http_runtime` gates, asserted directly.

nginx `/mcp/` proxies to a named `upstream rebar_mcp` whose `server` line is the materialized include `mcp-upstream*.conf`; the committed seed `infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` supplies `server 127.0.0.1:8091;`; and `materialize-mcp-upstream.sh` (called from `compose-up.sh`) installs it only-if-absent. Oracle: structural parse of the rendered template + seed + installer wiring (`nginx -t` when a binary is available).

SIGTERM grace: with `in_flight` > 0 a SIGTERM does NOT exit immediately and exits 0 once the gauge drains, within the 1200s bound — a subprocess/signal test driving the `_mcp_health` grace handler; and `stop_grace_period` (1260s) ≥ `DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS` (1200s), asserted structurally over compose + the module.
